Outreach.title: Outreach
Outreach.description: Represents an outreach event organized by a coordinator.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Outreach entity.

location.description: Location where the outreach event takes place.

participantIds.description: References to Users (Reachers). (Relationship: User N:N Outreach)

newConvertIds.description: References to NewConvert objects (Relationship: Outreach 1:N NewConvert)

status.description: Status of the outreach event (planned, ongoing, completed).

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the outreach event was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the outreach event was last updated.

NewConvert.title: NewConvert
NewConvert.description: Represents a new believer encountered during an outreach event.

id.description: Unique identifier for the NewConvert entity.

phone.description: Phone number of the new convert.

status.description: Status of the new convert (e.g., just met, follow-up scheduled).

notes.description: Additional notes about the new convert.

assignedTo.description: Reference to User (Reacher) assigned to follow up with the new convert. (Relationship: User 1:N NewConvert)

definition.description: Represents outreach events created by a specific coordinator. Includes denormalized 'participantIds' array for authorization independence.

definition.description: Represents new converts associated with a specific outreach event. Includes denormalized 'outreachId' for authorization independence. Includes also `assignedTo` to store the `userId` of the reacher assigned to follow up with the new convert.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore data structure is designed to support the Outreach feature, focusing on authorization independence, clarity, and scalability. It leverages path-based ownership for user-related data and denormalization to avoid complex security rules that require `get()` calls. The structure supports secure `list` operations (QAPs) by segregating data based on ownership and role. 

`users/{userId}/outreach_events/{outreachId}`:
This path establishes clear ownership of outreach events by coordinators. The coordinator, identified by `userId`, has exclusive access to create, update, and delete outreach events under their control. Participants are managed through denormalized `participantIds` array within each `outreach_events` document to maintain authorization independence. Security rules can easily enforce that only the coordinator (`userId`) can modify these documents.

`outreach_events/{outreachId}/new_converts/{newConvertId}`:
This structure enables each outreach event to manage its new converts. The `new_converts` subcollection is designed to store contact information and follow-up notes for each new convert. The `outreachId` is denormalized within each `new_converts` document to enforce the relationship and allow simple querying of new converts associated with a specific outreach event. Also, `assignedTo` field within the `new_converts` documents stores the `userId` of the reacher assigned to follow up with the new convert.

To achieve Authorization Independence:
The `coordinatorId` is stored in the `outreach_events` collection and the `outreachId` is stored in the `new_converts` collection. This eliminates the need for `get()` calls to verify the coordinator's ownership of the outreach or the reacher's assignment to the new convert.

To enable QAPs:
Each `outreach_events` document contains a `participantIds` array, representing the members of the outreach. Security rules can allow listing only if the authenticated user's `uid` is in the `participantIds` list, securing the list operation without filtering data after retrieval.
